query: Please implement a database management website for database maintenance and management. The website should have functionalities for database backup, recovery, performance optimization, and fault handling. Users should be able to log in, browse database information, perform database backups and recoveries, optimize database performance, and handle database faults. Set overall background to sky blue, then style components with navy.
